//: Strict base shared by tsconfig.node.json, tsconfig.web.json and tsconfig.test.json. Never compiled directly.
// module: Every bundle is produced by esbuild, never by tsc, so the module settings here exist only to describe how imports resolve. TypeScript 7 dropped the legacy `node` (node10) resolver; `bundler` is the mode that matches what esbuild actually does, and `ESNext` keeps import syntax untransformed so `verbatimModuleSyntax` can hold every file to explicit `import type`.
